name: tree-inference-support
description: Infer phylogenetic trees using maximum likelihood (RAxML-NG, IQ-TREE) and Bayesian (MrBayes, BEAST2) methods, and assess branch support. ML finds the tree topology and branch lengths that maximize the probability of observing the data under the substitution model. Bayesian methods sample the posterior distribution of trees proportional to likelihood times prior, providing credible intervals on topology and parameters.
